checks.explanation: No D-selection disclosure is present in the transcribed list, so its placement cannot be evaluated.
No basic services fee item with includesText is present to evaluate for adequacy.
The list shows only the receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial charges; no second mandatory facilities or handling fee is printed.
No D-embalming disclosure is present in the transcribed list.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial or closed-casket services.
The D-alt-container disclosure and the direct cremation range both appear on page 1, which counts as immediate conjunction.
The list offers direct cremation with purchaser-provided container and alternative containers, with no statement that a casket is required for cremation.
The direct cremation entries contain no description mentioning a crematory fee or cash advance to create ambiguity.
The list offers receiving remains but no separate price for forwarding remains to another funeral home, one of the four items the check expects to be itemized.
No optional package combining goods and services is present; receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not treated as packages.
No statement that law, cemetery or crematory requires a purchase is printed; the only related text is the prescribed alternative-container disclosure.
No language claims that goods delay decomposition or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and the sole disclosure is printed clearly on page 1.
